clusterOps.title: Danger zone
clusterOps.subtitle: Cluster-wide operations — every one requires typing the exact target name.
clusterOps.metaStepDown.desc: Ask the current meta leader to step down and trigger a new election.
clusterOps.streamStepDown.desc: Migrate a stream's leader to another replica.
clusterOps.balance.desc: Redistribute stream leaders across the cluster's servers.
clusterOps.peerRemove.desc: Remove a peer from the meta group or a stream's RAFT group.
clusterOps.conflict: An operation is already in progress — wait for it to finish.

metaStepDown.a: Triggers a meta-group re-election: the cluster runs without a meta leader until a new one is elected (typically a few seconds).
metaStepDown.b: JetStream API availability may briefly degrade during the election.

streamStepDown.a: Triggers a re-election inside the stream's RAFT group; the leader migrates to another replica (typically a few seconds).
streamStepDown.b: Publishes to the stream may pause briefly while the new leader settles.

balance.a: Stream leaders are redistributed across the cluster one by one (replica migration).
balance.b: Duration scales with the number of streams; each stream may pause briefly while its leader moves.

metaPeerRemove.a: The removed server cannot rejoin the meta group until the ENTIRE cluster is restarted.
metaPeerRemove.b: If the removed server holds the only replica (R1) of a stream, that stream's data is permanently lost.
metaPeerRemove.c: R1 stream consumer state is reset.

streamPeerRemove.a: The peer is removed from the stream's RAFT group; replicas migrate to the remaining peers (duration scales with stream size).
streamPeerRemove.b: If the removed peer holds the stream's only replica (R1), its data is permanently lost and R1 consumer state is reset.
